text: 广汽集团公告称，公司与中国第一汽车股份有限公司签署《意向协议》，筹划以发行股份方式购买一汽股份持有的某整车合资公司部分股权，并募集配套资金。本次交易预计构成重大资产重组及关联交易，不构成实际控制人变更及重组上市。公司A股股票自2026年9月14日开市起停牌，预计停牌时间不超过10个交易日。
text_en: GAC Group announced that the company signed a Letter of Intent with China FAW Co., Ltd., planning to acquire part of the equity of a certain vehicle joint venture held by FAW through the issuance of shares and to raise supporting funds. This transaction is expected to constitute a major asset restructuring and a related-party transaction, and will not constitute a change in the actual controller or a restructuring listing. The company's A-shares will be suspended from trading starting at market open on September 14, 2026, with the suspension expected to last no more than 10 trading days.
